subject.title: chore(compat): date the annotated deprecation families and expose removal-pending debt

question: Should OpenClaw formally mark these ten shipped plugin/runtime compatibility families as deprecated with 2026-10-01 as their earliest removal-review date?
rationale: The patch does not remove runtime behavior, but its registry records and published migration guidance set future compatibility expectations for external plugin and package consumers; that retirement calendar needs explicit owner acceptance.

options.title: Approve the dated retirement plan
options.body: Accept the 2026-10-01 review window and reader-gated removal conditions, then rebase and validate the exact merge result.

options.title: Narrow the record set
options.body: Keep only families with separately confirmed published-reader and migration evidence, and leave ambiguous surfaces undated until their owners define a removal condition.

recommendation.title: Approve the dated retirement plan
recommendation.body: Accept the 2026-10-01 review window and reader-gated removal conditions, then rebase and validate the exact merge result.
